title: publish's leak scan passes a GUID in a .py, .json or .csv file
goal: kbpublic.file_hits reports a GUID in any text file that is not a vendor export, snapshot or pinned artifact (a .py, .json or .csv as much as a .md), so kbgit.py publish refuses it unless the allowlist holds it, with a test named publish_guid_any_text that plants one in each of the three types; pinned files and vendor exports stay scanned for secrets only. Operator decision on BG-r5wzfz3c g1: keep GUID scanning in every text file at publish.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as k;sys.exit(0 if any(h[0]=='guid' for h in k.file_hits('x.py','t = "3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301"\n',set(),())) else 1)
